source: This is my preferred position. But unfortunately, it looks as though the courts will rule that Obama has gone too far.
zh: 这是我的首选位置。但不幸的是，法院似乎会裁定奥巴马太过分了。

source: We need to do something to drive turnout and keep Sanders supporters off of the sidelines. I will pledge to fight for universal health care as President.
zh: 我们需要采取一些措施来提高投票率并让桑德斯支持者远离场外。作为总统，我将承诺为全民医疗保健而奋斗。

source: I will repeat my opinion that the goal is desirable, but impractical in our current political environment.
zh: 我将重申我的观点，即该目标是可取的，但在我们当前的政治环境中不切实际。

source: Julian Castro is a bright, young, energetic man who will be perfectly ready to assume the Presidency from day one. He represents the best and brightest of the Hispanic community.
zh: 朱利安·卡斯特罗是一位聪明、年轻、精力充沛的人，从第一天起就已经做好了就任总统的充分准备。他代表了西班牙裔社区中最优秀和最聪明的人。

source: This is a signature accomplishment of the Obama Administration, and I support it whole-heartedly.
zh: 这是奥巴马政府的标志性成就，我全心全意地支持它。

source: I support this deal, but I will work very hard as President to see that it is aggressively enforced.
zh: 我支持这项协议，但作为总统我将非常努力地确保它得到积极执行。

source: This deal is a completely asinine joke. We still owe Iran $150 billion if we change our mind. We just give them the money.
zh: 这笔交易完全是一个愚蠢的笑话。如果我们改变主意，我们仍然欠伊朗1500亿美元。我们只是给他们钱。

source: I love fracking. We need to do anything we can to support it.
zh: 我喜欢水力压裂。我们需要尽我们所能来支持它。

source: Until green energy technologies are ready to shoulder the load, we need help from oil and fracking.
zh: 在绿色能源技术准备好承担重任之前，我们需要石油和水力压裂的帮助。

source: I'm opposed to fracking, and I think we need a lot more regulation of the practice.
zh: 我反对水力压裂，并且我认为我们需要对这种做法进行更多监管。

source: I support our police officers, who are working so hard to uphold the law in this country.
zh: 我支持我们的警察，他们正在努力维护这个国家的法律。

source: I support African-Americans in this country and I oppose police brutality. But these activists are a different story. There have been some very hateful things said, and they are tied to a number of riots that we've seen.
zh: 我支持这个国家的非裔美国人，我反对警察的暴行。但这些活动人士却是另一回事。有人说了一些非常可恶的话，它们与我们看到的一些骚乱有关。

source: I believe that black lives matter. I fully support this group in their objectives. They are the civil rights group of our time.
zh: 我相信黑人的生命很重要。我完全支持这个团体的目标。他们是我们这个时代的民权团体。

source: This is another case of radical Islamists attempting to destroy the values that we stand for. We have to admit that a huge part of Islam is at war with America and the western world, and we continue to have far too many people who are looking the other way.
zh: 这是激进伊斯兰主义者试图破坏我们所代表的价值观的另一个案例。我们必须承认，伊斯兰教的很大一部分正在与美国和西方世界交战，而且我们仍然有太多的人对此视而不见。

source: The first thing is, let's take a moment of respect for the people who were affected by this horrible tragedy. And I trust that the European authorities are on this case and over the coming weeks we will get more information about what happened.
zh: 首先，让我们向受这场可怕悲剧影响的人们表示敬意。我相信欧洲当局正在处理此案，在未来几周内我们将获得有关所发生事件的更多信息。

source: We're going to find whoever did this and bring them to justice. And let us remember, our country is at its best when we stand united. Islam is a religion of peace, and we only encourage the spread of terrorism if we overreact against innocent, patriotic Americans in the wake of this.
zh: 我们将找到肇事者并将他们绳之以法。让我们记住，当我们团结一致时，我们的国家就会处于最佳状态。伊斯兰教是和平的宗教，如果我们在此之后对无辜、爱国的美国人反应过度，我们只会鼓励恐怖主义的蔓延。

source: Mr. Trump's attacks are grotesque and outrageous. I trust that Americans of all persuasions will vote this type of rhetoric down in November.
zh: 特朗普先生的攻击是怪诞和令人发指的。我相信，无论何种派系的美国人都会在 11 月投票否决此类言论。

source: It's fine to support the police, but not in a way that deflects questions about Black Lives Matter or seems to imply that movement isn't helpful.
zh: 支持警察很好，但不能以某种方式转移有关“黑人生命也是命”的问题，或者似乎暗示该运动没有帮助。

source: Of course, The Donald is already using these attacks to agitate for further measures against Muslims... and to blame you and the Obama Administration for incompetence.
zh: 当然，唐纳德已经在利用这些攻击来鼓动针对穆斯林采取进一步措施......并指责你和奥巴马政府的无能。

source: Progressives fear that you are planning to abandon the $12/hour push, now that you have gotten Sanders out of the way.
zh: 进步人士担心，既然您已经摆脱了桑德斯，您就计划放弃 12 美元/小时的推动。

source: The attacks themselves are bad enough, but the way you have swung to the right in your own positions is disheartening to many progressives.
zh: 攻击本身已经够糟糕的了，但你在自己的立场上向右转的方式让许多进步人士感到沮丧。

source: The Donald seems to be specializing in gutter politics this year.
zh: 唐纳德今年似乎专门研究阴沟政治。

source: This brings a rousing cheer from your supporters, but is a signifiant break with your position so far.
zh: 这给你的支持者带来了振奋人心的欢呼，但迄今为止，这是对你立场的重大突破。

source: This is a moderate enough position, but progressives and Hispanics sense that you trying to back away from your earlier pledges on this issue.
zh: 这是一个足够温和的立场，但进步人士和西班牙裔人感觉到你试图背弃之前在这个问题上的承诺。

source: This is a moderate stance, but is that the best option in this election? Many Democrats want to hear more from you.
zh: 这是一个温和的立场，但这是这次选举的最佳选择吗？许多民主党人希望听到你的更多信息。

source: This is a surprisingly progressive position, compared to what your stance was in the primaries. But it is definitely making the news today.
zh: 与您在初选时的立场相比，这是一个令人惊讶的进步立场。但这绝对是今天的新闻。

source: This type of incrementalism is leaving many Democrats uninspired.
zh: 这种渐进主义让许多民主党人失去了灵感。

source: You are continuing your liberal rhetoric on immigration.
zh: 您继续在移民问题上发表自由主义言论。

source: You're stating your own position very clearly on this issue.
zh: 您在这个问题上非常清楚地表明了自己的立场。

source: Your renunciation of Black Lives Matter does not sit well with the progressive movement.
zh: 你放弃“黑人的命也是命”与进步运动并不相符。

source: A spoon full of sugar helps the medicine go down?
zh: 一勺糖能帮助药下去吗？

source: There's a lot of confusion over your change of heart.
zh: 你改变主意引起了很多困惑。

source: As tragic as any act of terrorism is, you have been sounding the alarm on radical Islam while your opponent refuses to mention the term.
zh: 与任何恐怖主义行为一样悲惨，你一直在对激进伊斯兰教发出警报，而你的对手却拒绝提及这个词。

source: A lot of supporters are confused that you have backed away from your earlier rhetoric on Islam, particularly after a huge terrorist attack.
zh: 许多支持者对你放弃了之前关于伊斯兰教的言论感到困惑，特别是在发生大规模恐怖袭击之后。

source: What was your rationale behind selecting Elizabeth Warren as your running mate?
zh: 您选择伊丽莎白·沃伦作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

source: In the wake of Trump's nomination, a number of prominent anti-Trump Republicans are organizing to cast votes for Libertarian Gary Johnson as a protest, with an emphasis on the Western states. What are your thoughts?
zh: 在特朗普获得提名后，一些著名的反特朗普共和党人正在组织投票给自由意志主义者加里·约翰逊以示抗议，重点是西方各州。你有什么想法？

source: There has been a coordinated, violent terrorist attack on London today, resulting in the death of at least 100 people. How will you address this?
zh: 今天伦敦发生了一起协调一致的暴力恐怖袭击，导致至少 100 人死亡。您将如何解决这个问题？

source: At a Trump rally today, a deranged supporter fired at several protestors before he was tackled. Are these rallies getting out of hand?
zh: 在今天的特朗普集会上，一名精神错乱的支持者在被制服之前向几名抗议者开枪。这些集会是否会失控？

source: The FBI has recommended the indictment of several of your aides, based on classified intelligence which they obtained from secure facilities and emailed to you. Do you have any comment?
zh: FBI 根据从安全设施获得并通过电子邮件发送给您的机密情报，建议起诉您的几名助手。您有何评论？

source: Donald Trump is attacking you almost daily on your 2002 vote in favor of the Iraq War. How do you plan to respond?
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普几乎每天都在攻击你 2002 年投票支持伊拉克战争。你打算如何回应？

source: Do you support the construction of a 20-foot wall along the entire length of the U.S.-Mexico border?
zh: 您是否支持沿美墨边境修建一堵 20 英尺高的墙？

source: Do you support the recent reopening of relations with Cuba?
zh: 您支持最近与古巴重新开放关系吗？

source: Trump is lying if he says he opposed this war. There's no evidence or recorded statement of his opposition until well after the war began.
zh: 特朗普如果他说他反对这场战争，那他就是在撒谎。直到战争开始很久之后，才出现他反对的证据或记录的声明。

source: I had to make a decision based on the evidence we had at the time. I would not make this vote, knowing what I know today.
zh: 我必须根据我们当时掌握的证据做出决定。就我今天所知道的情况而言，我不会投票。

source: We would have stabilized Iraq and won a great victory there, if we hadn't pulled out so hastily.
zh: 如果我们没有如此仓促地撤军，我们本来可以稳定伊拉克局势并在那里赢得伟大胜利。

source: It isn't my place to step into these kinds of disputes. I would hope that people see Hillary Clinton as the best candidate for President when they look at the ballot.
zh: 我无权介入此类争议。我希望人们在查看选票时将希拉里·克林顿视为总统的最佳候选人。

source: I believe, regardless of how we feel about Donald Trump, that he won his party's nomination and should not be challenged in this manner.
zh: 我相信，无论我们对唐纳德·特朗普有何看法，他赢得了政党的提名，不应该以这种方式受到挑战。

source: Elizabeth Warren is a good friend and an icon of the progressive movement. There are very few people in this country who have done more to advance progressive ideals than Ms. Warren.
zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦是一个好朋友，也是进步运动的偶像。在这个国家，很少有人能比沃伦女士为推进进步理想做出更多贡献。

source: This is yet another example, like Benghazi or many others, of a politically motivated witch hunt. I support my associates completely, and fully expect to see their names cleared before this is done.
zh: 这是另一个例子，就像班加西或许多其他例子一样，出于政治动机的政治迫害。我完全支持我的同事，并完全希望在这件事完成之前看到他们的名字被洗清。

source: I will immediately apologize for any lapses that occurred while I was Secretary of State, and will pledge to do anything possible to cooperate moving forward, so that we can get to the bottom of this.
zh: 我将立即对我担任国务卿期间发生的任何失误表示歉意，并承诺尽一切可能进行合作，以便我们能够查明真相。

source: Repeatedly, Mr. Trump has refused to acknowledge the consequences of his divisive rhetoric, and events at his rallies continue to escalate. What will it take for him to acknowledge that he is responsible?
zh: 特朗普先生一再拒绝承认他的分裂言论的后果，并且他集会上的事件继续升级。他怎样才能承认自己有责任？

source: Whatever our thoughts, let's send our prayers for the people affected and hope that no further incidents occur in the future.
zh: 无论我们有什么想法，让我们为受影响的人们祈祷，并希望未来不再发生类似事件。

source: We're going to build the wall, and Mexico is going to pay for it.
zh: 我们要修建隔离墙，墨西哥将支付费用。

source: Maybe this issue has been caught up in a bit of rhetorical excess, but I will be very tough on illegal immigration when I am President.
zh: 也许这个问题有点言过其实，但当我担任总统时，我将对非法移民采取非常强硬的态度。

source: This is one of the most far-fetched ideas that I've heard in my political career.
zh: 这是我在政治生涯中听到的最牵强的想法之一。

source: The way our current President has been kowtowing to the repressive leaders of Cuba is a disgrace. It really is.
zh: 我们现任总统向古巴镇压领导人卑躬屈膝的方式是一种耻辱。确实如此。

source: I'm glad that we have reached out to Cuba, but I would like to have seen a little more insistence that they liberalize their country first.
zh: 我很高兴我们已经与古巴接触，但我希望看到他们更加坚持首先让他们的国家自由化。

source: I fully support Barack Obama's actions in regards to Cuba.
zh: 我完全支持贝拉克·奥巴马针对古巴的行动。

source: Obama has come under some criticism, but many people also favor the new stance towards Cuba.
zh: 奥巴马受到了一些批评，但许多人也赞成对古巴的新立场。

source: Of course, this type of dissension in the Republican ranks only helps you.
zh: 当然，共和党队伍中的这种分歧只会对你有帮助。
